verdict.rationale: Aider is itself an AI coding agent, which is the MCP client role. Serving tools to other agents through an MCP server is a different product role. Nothing in the evidence shows Aider running as an MCP server, such as an 'mcp serve' mode or a hosted endpoint, so this axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
